question.problem:
The daily number of customers to a particular cafe declines according to the expression $500\cdot (0.83)^{t}$, where $t$ is the number of days since the local news reported that the cafe did not pass a health inspection. 
What does the base of the exponential expression $(0.83)$ mean in this context?

choices.value: The number of customers decreases by $17%$ every day
The number of customers increases by $83%$ every day
The number of customers decreases by $83%$ every day
The number of customers increases by $17%$ every day

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195578/assets/ef47ff747a4899500bf1cdaa584e477954cd417238e8b7e695862da9b0022c6a.svg) where ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195578/assets/3a4ef1c1b261a53f9c45d0c90f2d44b155125fe1e7b1359406830111b4846f2f.svg) is the decay rate.

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195578/assets/707bb132def3690d81bf1f0c8cf416c1382322ab19d66264cdab1decc4669307.svg) is the time since the car was first purchased, in years.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195578/assets/64161e1a2f19b6bdb3f7651e8a553179126ccf33901d20311347dbd9ff98aaab.svg)

Now, ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195578/assets/85eb3227c042f8ec4de535b2fb7fc37c5cd34735961e5ba26e6a511eff5707b5.svg) (expressed as a percent) is equal to ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195578/assets/92e44f079247c93011878456e1294adc24fe51c089fd07e12107f1ad75e2d91d.svg)
